limitations: Nine fixtures are listed above because the deployed snapshot predates them; the four-hour publisher is the only thing that can price them, and it replays its own first-party sources.

resolution.summary: All nine fixtures this dossier researched are now published with a pick and two probabilities by the four-hour publisher; none of the nine needs a hand-written number.
resolution.independence_note: The dossier is HLTV-first research: rankings, the HLTV match binding and market availability.
